title: Paul's Hardships, The Temple of the Living God

questions.question: Working together with him, then, we appeal to you not to receive the grace of God in ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 6:1 (ESV): "Working together with him, then, we appeal to you not to receive the grace of God in vain."

questions.question: For he says, "In a favorable time I listened to you, and in a day of salvation I have helped you." Behold, now is the ____ time; behold, now is the day of salvation.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 6:2 (ESV): "For he says, 'In a favorable time I listened to you, and in a day of salvation I have helped you.' Behold, now is the favorable time; behold, now is the day of salvation."

questions.question: We put no obstacle in anyone's way, so that no fault may be found with our ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 6:3 (ESV): "We put no obstacle in anyone's way, so that no fault may be found with our ministry,"

questions.question: Instead, as servants of God we commend ourselves in every way: by great ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 6:4 (ESV): "but as servants of God we commend ourselves in every way: by great endurance, in afflictions, hardships, calamities,"

questions.question: Paul lists many extreme circumstances they endured. Which of these is NOT in his list in verses 4-5?
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 6:4-5 (ESV): "...by great endurance, in afflictions, hardships, calamities, beatings, imprisonments, riots, labors, sleepless nights, hunger;" Shipwrecks are mentioned in 2 Corinthians 11, but not in this specific list in chapter 6.

questions.question: We commend ourselves by purity, knowledge, patience, kindness, the Holy Spirit, ____,
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 6:6 (ESV): "by purity, knowledge, patience, kindness, the Holy Spirit, genuine love;"

questions.question: by truthful speech, and the power of God; with the weapons of ____ for the right hand and for the left;
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 6:7 (ESV): "by truthful speech, and the power of God; with the weapons of righteousness for the right hand and for the left;"

questions.question: Paul gives a series of paradoxes: "as unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and behold, we live; as ____, and yet not killed;"
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 6:9 (ESV): "as unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and behold, we live; as punished, and yet not killed;"

questions.question: "as sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many ____; as having nothing, yet possessing everything."
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 6:10 (ESV): "as sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, yet possessing everything."

questions.question: Paul appeals to the Corinthians: "We have spoken freely to you, Corinthians; our heart is ____."
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 6:11 (ESV): "We have spoken freely to you, Corinthians; our heart is wide open."

questions.question: He says they are not restricted by Paul and his companions, but they are restricted in their own ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 6:12 (ESV): "You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted in your own affections."

questions.question: Do not be unequally yoked with ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 6:14 (ESV): "Do not be unequally yoked with unbelievers. For what partnership has righteousness with lawlessness? Or what fellowship has light with darkness?"

questions.question: What partnership has righteousness with ____? Or what fellowship has light with darkness?
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 6:14 (ESV): "For what partnership has righteousness with lawlessness? Or what fellowship has light with darkness?"

questions.question: What agreement has the temple of God with ____? For we are the temple of the living God.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 6:16 (ESV): "What agreement has the temple of God with idols? For we are the temple of the living God..."

questions.question: "Therefore go out from their midst, and be separate from them, says the Lord, and touch no ____ thing; then I will welcome you,"
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 6:17 (ESV): "Therefore go out from their midst, and be separate from them, says the Lord, and touch no unclean thing; then I will welcome you,"

key_verse_text: What agreement has the temple of God with idols? For we are the temple of the living God; as God said, "I will make my dwelling among them and walk among them, and I will be their God, and they shall be my people."
